lifecycle.static_verification_limit: The offline validator checks structure, exact vocabulary, cross-record consistency and plausibility only; reviewer identity, PR, merge commit and CI runs must be independently verified against GitHub. CLOSED additionally requires the merge evidence to equal the independently verified record pinned in the validator by the governed post-merge step; until then CLOSED fails closed.

deferred.item: Evidence-content viewing, content-permission flows and evidence review
DetectionResult presentation, classification labels, explanation and uncertainty
Re-analysis, retry-after-failure, user correction, replay and governed deletion of evidence
Detailed accessibility patterns, responsive breakpoints and the unsupported-language experience

scope_differences: Evidence content access is limited to the metadata/content boundary statement; content viewing is P7-WP4 (UX-001 handoff).
Evaluation is covered only as the explicit initial analysis request and pending/terminal status hand-off; result presentation is P7-WP3.
Retry-after-failure, re-analysis and correction requests (predecessor_evaluation_id, createCorrection) are P7-WP5.
Consent capture has no accepted API field; only supported instruction requirements are specified.
roadmap.md lists only UX-001 / REPORT-001 for Phase 7; the accepted UX-001 work-package decomposition governs.

upload_state_presentation.meaning: Not finalized. The server has not reported stored bytes. No analysis outcome, verdict or safety is implied.
Not finalized. Not proof that bytes were received or verified. The server may still be storing, verifying or retrying. No analysis outcome, verdict or safety is implied.
Bytes durably stored and digest-verified by the server. Evidence is preserved, not analysed. No analysis outcome, verdict or safety is implied.
Not usable; the client cannot resume it, and server reconciliation may still change its state. No analysis outcome, verdict or safety is implied.
Governed removal is in progress; content is not shown. No analysis outcome, verdict or safety is implied.
Removed under governance; never reconstructed or previewed. No analysis outcome, verdict or safety is implied.

submission_state_presentation.meaning: Submission open for evidence intake. No analysis outcome, verdict or safety is implied.
Evidence intake recorded by the server. Analysis is a separate request. No analysis outcome, verdict or safety is implied.
Server-side processing recorded. No analysis outcome, verdict or safety is implied.
Server-side processing recorded as finished. No analysis outcome, verdict or safety is implied.
Some processing failed; items that are not finalized are shown. No analysis outcome, verdict or safety is implied.
Processing failed. No analysis outcome, verdict or safety is implied.

intake_presentation_states.meaning: Material exists only on the user's device; nothing has been submitted.
Bytes are being sent; sending is not storage, verification or analysis.
A transfer was interrupted before a response; whether the server stored the bytes is unknown until metadata is re-read.
Whether a command was accepted cannot be established from the original outcome or a permitted authoritative read; no blind resubmission.
The response omitted or used an unrecognised lifecycle value; re-read authoritative state; no optimistic state is shown.
Evidence is preserved but no analysis has been requested.
A fresh or unordered server state contradicts an earlier observation in a way the lifecycle cannot explain; neither state is shown as confirmed; re-read and reconcile.

by_upload_state.reason: The first PUT is allowed while AWAITING_CONTENT.

PROCESSING may be CONTENT_PENDING or FAILED_RETRYABLE; readiness is unobservable.

A new item is an explicit user decision; the original may still be reconciled by the server (possible duplicate).

instructions.statement: Uploading and preserving evidence is not an analysis result and never means safe.
Analysis is requested as a separate step and its result is presented separately.
A submitted URL is treated as text evidence; TrustLens does not open, fetch or preview it.
Current detection scope is English (ADR-0014); other languages are not evaluated as safe.
The original material is preserved unmodified; corrections never edit it.
Submitted material is sensitive evidence; visibility follows permissions.
Retention wording stays policy-neutral; no period is stated while OI-05 is open.

non_goals: No frontend, React, CSS, routes, FastAPI, SQL/migrations or external network integration.
No new endpoint, API field, HTTP status, error code or persisted concept.
No evidence-content viewer, review or permission flow (P7-WP4).
No result, classification, explanation or recommended-action presentation (P7-WP3).
No re-analysis, correction, replay, report or deletion flow (P7-WP5).
No screenshot/image or document capture (Post-MVP / future).
No consent capture without an accepted API field.
No client-side scoring, probability, verdict, deduplication or language gating.

PUT_SUCCESS_OBSERVED.meaning: This client received the successful putEvidenceContent response for this evidence item and this exact upload attempt.
PUT_SUCCESS_OBSERVED.attempt_identity_rule: Response evidence_id equals the item to finalize and response content_sha256 equals the digest of the exact bytes this client sent in this attempt.
